description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Fanatic of Rhonas.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
